messages:
harper-l: Heads-up: marketing needs a compact competitor cheat-sheet for next week's webinar outreach. Target: SDRs + AE playbook. Ask = 3 quick wins vs cloud AI, LLM APIs, infra vendors + one short benchmark blurb + 3 example AE prompts. Can someone spin this up by EOD?

ollie-r: I can draft the cloud AI platform section. Quick framing: managed infra is easy but opaque economics and limited rollout fidelity. Field line: 'Managed = fewer knobs, more surprises on cost.'

nina-m: Ill take LLM API players. Emphasize model breadth vs serving controls, and that many APIs don't give private deployment options. Proposed SDR line: 'Great for quick prototyping; not for predictable production economics.'

kevin-s: I'll handle infra vendors (self-hosted runtimes). Key points: you get maximal control but also ops/team drain. AE hook: 'We remove the heavy lifting so your ML team builds features, not infra.'

harper-l: For the benchmark blurb, keep it defensible and simple. Suggest relative claims and a tiny table style snippet. Something like:
```
chat workload (256 avg tokens):
- Redwood Hosted: p95 ~200-300ms, normalized cost = 1x
- Cloud managed endpoints: p95 ~400-600ms, normalized cost = ~1.8-2x
- Self-hosted (ops overhead): p95 variable (200-400ms), effective cost depends on ops spend
```
Keep numbers as ranges and say "typical customers see" to avoid absolutes.

sam-bot: FYI: webinar registrant export will be available at 5pm PST — use for targeted follow-up. Link: https://events.redwood.ai/exports

nina-m: Also add three quick rebuttals per competitor (one-liners). Drafts: 
- Cloud AI: 'Managed endpoints can spike costs and lack deterministic rollout controls.'
- LLM APIs: 'Wide model catalogs, limited production tooling for rollouts and regressions.'
- Infra vendors: 'Flexibility costs time — you still need routing, fallback, and KV caching.'

ollie-r: Add an AE prompt section: suggested opener, qualification Q, and rebuttal question: 
- Opener: 'How are you managing latency and unit cost for your chat features today?'
- Qual: 'Do you need private deployment or predictable reserved capacity?'
- Rebuttal Q: 'If cost spikes or a model regresses, how quickly can you rollback or route to a fallback?'

kevin-s: Security one-liner for enterprise reps: 'Private (VPC/on-prem) + KMS/HSM options; audit logs + routing controls for compliance.' Put that under "Enterprise Concerns."

harper-l: Great. Format request: 1-pager cheat-sheet (top half for SDRs, bottom half for AEs) + 2 slide hero deck for webinar. Keep language short, bullets only.

leah-p: Ill assemble a single doc and add quick visual callouts (icons for cost, latency, control). ETA 6pm. Assigning review to product for benchmark phrasing.

harper-l: Perfect. If product flags absolutes, swap to relative wording like '~2x' or 'typically slower at p95'. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
